purpose: New independent nested-S retraining with complete checkpoints and independent replay; not recovery of original weights or a search for improved scores.
selection_tie_break: validation subject AUC, smaller learning rate, earlier epoch; preserve frozen engine
pilot_role: First full-budget outer fold is part of the 155, not an additional or shortened experiment.
engineering_gate_only: Advance only after independent checkpoint replay; no outer test metric gate, hyperparameter changes, seed selection or target tuning.
parallelism_gate: At most two train-or-validate tasks; first task serial, then require sufficient measured GPU/memory resources and no unowned GPU tasks.
device_assignment: Disjoint task allocation recorded before running each allocation; validator must use the task's original GPU environment.
resume_policy: Skip only verified PASS tasks; independently validate already trained tasks; partial/failed tasks stop and are never retrained automatically.
historical_source_binding: Available archived source snapshot, not proven identical to the historical executed source.
historical_results: Retained unchanged; new five-seed OOF results and any per-seed differences reported separately, with no promise of bitwise equality.
shutdown_policy: Never power off shared free 4060 or no-GPU data host. Paid GPU shutdown only after all assigned tasks are validated, downloaded and SHA-verified.
